**Implementation complete. 15/15 tasks done. 20/20 tests pass.**

| What changed | File |
|---|---|
| New rate limiting module | `src/api/rate_limit.py` |
| Routers wired with `check_rate_limit` | `src/api/main.py` |
| Fresh-limiter fixtures added | `tests/conftest.py` |
| 9 new tests (US1 + US2) | `tests/test_rate_limit.py` |

**One fix during implementation**: `X-RateLimit-*` headers on 429 responses must be passed inside `HTTPException(headers=...)` — FastAPI discards the injected `Response` object's headers when an exception is raised. All headers now flow correctly on both 200 and 429 paths.
